# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the ZavaLoanPortal application assessment. Each document focuses on a specific aspect of the application architecture and design.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer architecture visualization: high-level application architecture (layers, external services, data flow) and detailed component relationship diagram |
| [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category, with version and compatibility risk analysis |
| [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) | Service catalog, API endpoints inventory, communication patterns, DTOs, and service interaction sequence diagram |
| [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model ER diagram, repository methods, caching strategy, and data classification |
| [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, properties, secrets, and framework versions |
| [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) | Core business workflows, domain entities, service-to-domain mapping, and business rules documentation |
